lean_verified_library_experiment.interpretation: No gap by the preregistered rule (intervals overlap on every outcome). Reuse is real (proof-term deps: N 0, P 7-9, Q 14, S 13-14 of which 6-8 cross-agent) but did not lower calls or tokens; library prompts cost roughly what reuse saves. Wall time is lower for S (parallel) than Q (sequential) - a parallelism effect, not evidence about sharing (S vs P overlap). Consistent with Berlot-Attwell 2504.03048; not a new mechanism.

bench_v12_headroom_check.interpretation: Claude 121/127 (95.3%) meets the preregistered >=95% 'no headroom' rule only barely; its 6 errors are all on held-out families and 5 of 6 are false refusals; Gemini 110/127 (86.6%) has headroom concentrated in wavelength_formula_licence (7/14 wrong) and greenhill_buckling (6/13 wrong), i.e. exactly the families with convention dependence. Item-level intervals are descriptive; effective n is 8 families. Not a model ranking. Says nothing about tissues; declared-model checks only.
